highlights: Agent Chat no longer stalls, or reports OpenClaw as unavailable, while the gateway is only busy: runtime verification moved off the chat request path.
Replies from Claude CLI models appear once instead of two or three times.
An open Chat tab stops sweeping every agent's sessions and pauses its background checks while hidden.
Project downloads start sooner and no longer freeze the Portal while the archive is prepared.
Smoother streaming under load: status checks no longer block the Portal while they run.
